title: CRASH-103: stristr zval_ptr_dtor on own passed args double free uaf (use-after-free)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: our native ASan build of the pinned 5.0.0 tarball (p12, gcc 15.2.0, libasan from gcc 15, 2026-10-27) reports ASAN:heap-use-after-free at Zend/zend_execute_API.c:389 in _zval_ptr_dtor when trigger.php runs; the corpus records the fix as php-src 90f4590d87fe, which postdates the release, and names the defect at ext/standard/string.c:1412-1413 (also 1385-1386 on the empty-needle path)
fidelity: the corpus's own trigger script, run through the real interpreter (PHP's cli SAPI, ext/standard only, the port's 145 translation units) rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it. The pristine build completes it natively, so an arm that completes it saw nothing.
